units.source_text: 與人交往時，我最警惕這種可怕的沉默場面出現，

en.t: When dealing with people, I was always most wary of that dreadful silence appearing,

units.source_text: 所以，生性沉默寡言的我，才會先聲奪人地拼命搞笑，

en.t: so I, naturally quiet and inarticulate, would rush in first and desperately try to be funny,

units.source_text: 可是，現在堀木這個蠢貨自己卻無意識地承擔了搞笑的角色，

en.t: but now this fool Horiki had unconsciously taken on the role of clown himself,

units.source_text: 我根本用不著接他的話茬，只要當作耳旁風，

en.t: so I had no need to take up his remarks at all and could simply let them pass by,

units.source_text: 偶爾笑著敷衍一句「怎麼可能」就行了。

en.t: only occasionally smiling and brushing him off with a phrase like, "As if," and that was enough.

units.source_text: 不久我也漸漸明白，煙、酒和妓女都是暫時消除我對人類的恐懼的絕妙手段。

en.t: Before long I gradually came to understand that cigarettes, alcohol, and prostitutes were all excellent means of temporarily dispelling my fear of human beings.

units.source_text: 為了尋求這些手段，我甚至覺得變賣一切家當也在所不惜，無怨無悔。

en.t: In pursuit of these means, I even felt I would not mind selling off all my possessions and would have no regrets.
